messages:
Priya Sharma: Heads-up — we have ~18 tenants in onboarding stuck on indexing+auth since 02:10 UTC. I drafted an outbound we can send in the morning; need quick edit pass and sign-off for credit offer and office-hours invite.
Sam Ortega: thanks — can you paste the draft here? also list of tenant IDs so we can map to renewals.
Priya Sharma: pasted below. affected tenants: T-1012, T-1045, T-1099, T-1101, T-1120, T-1155, plus 11 smaller trial accounts. draft: "Hi — we saw your onboarding stall due to an indexing backlog and transient auth failures. We're actively backfilling your index and have a mitigation that will complete by EOD. We'll also apply a one-time onboarding credit and invite you to a dedicated onboarding office hours session. Reply if you want proactive assistance migrating partial indexes."
Maya Chen: wording looks good. suggest adding concrete ETA window and a link to troubleshooting doc. also recommend "what we did" + "what you can expect" bullets.
Priya Sharma: updated draft with bullets and ETA. also added link: https://redwood.example.com/docs/onboard-faq
Jon Patel: product note — the root cause is a race in the indexing worker when upstream auth returns 401 during the db-write window; we're patching but the long-lived fix rolls next week. short-term mitigation is rate-limiting the retry loop and prioritizing initial prefixes.
Sam Ortega: add renewal-risk flag for any account with activation date > 30 days and MRR > $5k. we should route those to high-touch list and offer a scheduled call.
Priya Sharma: good call. I'll attach a renewal-risk tag and propose the following comm tiers in the outbound: Tier A (priority enterprise) — personal CS outreach + credit + onboarding engineer; Tier B (mid) — credit + office hours; Tier C (trial/smb) — templated note + self-serve help link.
Maya Chen: ops reminder — include a short feedback ask: 1) how useful was the help, 2) did onboarding meet expectations, 3) anything we could improve. capture replies in the shared spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/OnboardFeedback
Priya Sharma: action items: 1) Sam — compile priority list and add renewal tags (ETA 90m). 2) Maya — confirm credit amounts for tiers and prepare refund/credit ops playbook (ETA 3h). 3) Jon — post hotfix branch and coordinate canary (ETA 6h). 4) Priya — finalize email copy and send at 08:00 local for affected regions, post message in customer portal.
Sam Ortega: on it. also setting a short Zapier automation to flag Slack threads for any reply that contains "activation" or "blocked" so we don't miss inbound customer replies.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-17. Priority: P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, cs-ops.
Maya Chen: small copy tweak suggestion: replace "one-time onboarding credit" with exact amounts for Tier A/B/C to reduce follow-ups.
Priya Sharma: agreed. tier amounts proposed: A: $2,500 credit + 3 hours onboarding engineering; B: $500 credit + office hours; C: $50 credit. I'll add to the draft.
Sam Ortega: compiled list attached to thread (private doc) — ping me if you need temp access to tie back to renewals.
Priya Sharma: final draft attached. sending plan: email + in-app banner + dedicated scheduling link for enterprise. we'll capture responses and update the feedback sheet. please review before 07:30 PT.
Jon Patel: noted. engineering will release hotfix to canary by 12:00 PT and watch index throughput. if we see >50% reduction in retries, we'll trigger broader rollout.
Maya Chen: when outbound goes, I'll spin up the office-hours calendar (2 slots) and add invite link to the email.
Priya Sharma: thanks team. once outbound is sent, I'll post a short customer summary here and set a follow-up for a 48h check-in and a short survey. :thumbsup:
CS Ops Bot: Reminder set for 48 hours post-send to collect feedback and compile a recap.
Priya Sharma: closing note — keep responses short and route any "billing" or "legal" questions to me directly. I'll own exec comms if any renewal flags escalate.
Sam Ortega: copy that.
Maya Chen: thanks all — will update once credits ops playbook is ready.
